message: The other day, I found myself in a bit of a 'smug I told you so' moment. My kids were grumbling as I insisted on checking our go-bags for the umpteenth time, and I could practically hear their eye rolls. But when the storm warnings came through later that evening, we were all so thankful we had everything ready to go. It’s those little moments that remind me how important it is to be prepared, even if it feels a bit over the top sometimes. What’s your favorite tip for staying ready at home?
